notes: Cash basis; Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (pp5-6) Total Governmental Funds column (p6), which nets a 75,000 elimination (Depreciation Fund transfer in vs. General Fund Student transportation 'Property') out of both receipts and disbursements, so top-level transfers are null and Student transportation is 196,750 (271,750 - 75,000). Beginning/ending cash = total governmental fund balances 5,543,582 / 7,041,873 (include due from County Treasurer). Roll-forward: 5,543,582 + 12,319,018 - 10,820,727 = 7,041,873. 'Other local receipts' (984,815) split using the fund budget schedules (General, Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Special Building, Bond, and now the Activity Fund schedule on p15: interest 4,422 + activities receipts 300,474); 'County receipts' and 'Other non-revenue receipts' split from the General Fund schedule. Statement 'Taxes' = levied property tax only (4,145,128 + 391,582 + 801,502). Business-type: School Nutrition fund (cash measure): 157,365 + 250,893 - 308,965 = 99,293; the USDA and State subsidy 135,358 split federal 133,851 / state 1,507 from p14. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis Total column (p1; no liabilities printed, total_liabilities null). Detail: General Fund expenditures taken from the Supporting Schedule of Cash Disbursements (program x object, pp16-18), which supersedes the function-only lines of the budget schedule (so those lines, and the 'Transfers (outgoing)' line with budget 400,000 and actual 0, are not repeated; budget amounts not available by object); General Fund revenue from the budget schedule. Hidden transfer: Student transportation 'Property' 75,000 is shown as an other financing -75,000 line (not as spending); the printed General Fund total 9,152,297 includes it; the Depreciation Fund shows the matching +75,000 transfer in (p10). Activity Fund schedule (p15) is a one-line budget schedule (no per-account detail); Activity Fund spending 399,319 is shown on the statement as Central services and recorded as student activities. Object mapping: 'Purchased property services' -> repairs and maintenance, 'Other property services' -> professional/contract services, 'Miscellaneous' -> miscellaneous expenditure (review). School Nutrition and Activity 'Transfer from general fund' actuals are dashes (0) with budgets 70,000 / 175,000 (included in the printed receipt totals). Depreciation 'Property' and Special Building 'Property' mapped to equipment purchases. 'Central services' 446,130 split by fund column (Activity Fund 399,319 -> student activities; General + Employee Benefit 46,811 -> support services); 'State receipts' split to move nameplate capacity tax 1,444 (pp8, 12, 13) to other taxes, matching detail.
